# Hair by Halli J

> Halli Miller is a hair stylist in Logan, Utah, at The Hair Studio Salon & Spa (120 E. 200 N., Logan, UT). She specializes in blonding and foil work, lived-in color, brunettes, hair extensions, and haircuts.

- Phone: 425-395-5021
- Book online: https://www.vagaro.com/thehairstudiosalonandspa (select Halli)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hairby.hallij/
- Website: https://hairbyhallij.com/

## Starting prices
- Blonding/foil work from $110; lived-in color/lowlights from $100; all-over color/root retouch from $80; toner/gloss from $45
- Extensions: free consultation, customized pricing
- Women's cut $40; dry trim $25; men's cut $30; children (10 and under) $20; special occasion styling from $50
